title: artocarpus integrifolius var. glaber
intro: Artocarpus integrifolius var. glaber, commonly known as the Breadfruit, is a plant species belonging to the Moraceae family. The Breadfruit is a rich source of nutrition and provides several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in weight management. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of Breadfruit include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
